comparison.objective: Load four connector modules into a hinged frame and click it shut; candidate removes one terminal from a housing.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated module alignment/seating followed by frame compression and latching versus single-blade access beneath a terminal lock and coupled extraction.
comparison.success_condition: All four modules seated, frame clicked closed, hands clear; candidate requires one terminal out without housing/crimp damage or neighbor release, with numeric thresholds absent.
comparison.reason: Both concern electrical connector hardware, but one tests multi-module insertion/frame closure and the other tests fine terminal depinning.
